query: For all datasets, we processed the EMG signals offline using a standardised approach (d'Avella and Lacquaniti, 2013): the EMGs for each sample were digitally full-wave rectified, low-pass filtered (Butterworth filter; 20 Hz cut-off; zero-phase distortion), normalised to 1000 time-samples and then the signals were integrated over 20 time-step intervals yielding a waveform of ~50 time-steps.
